item.title: EplayerX 1.2.58
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 修复在画中画里切换剧集时，字幕和弹幕可能消失的问题。 - 改善从 iPhone 接续 Emby 或 Jellyfin 播放。使用支持新版接续功能的 iPhone 版时，即使同一个服务器在两台设备上分别添加，Mac 也能根据服务器和账号识别对应配置。 - 改善部分视频标注的分辨率与实际画面不一致时的播放兼容性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。
## What’s New
- Fixed subtitles and on-screen comments disappearing when switching episodes in Picture in Picture. - Improved Emby and Jellyfin playback handoff from iPhone. With a compatible iPhone version, your Mac can match the server and account even when the server was added separately on each device. - Improved playback compatibility for some videos whose reported resolution differs from the encoded picture.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later.
